sources: Umbra of Frigid Eventide. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_funnel_0019 (weapon skill 3; values at its level: phy_spell_up 35–98, wind_grant 4, spell_dmg_up2 0.04–0.112). Its static Arts DMG (spell_dmg_up) and the other two skills' Agility and ATK are stat-panel modifiers (cardAttributeModifier), not here.

On the wielder's battle-skill cast (abilityEvent 30, CheckSkillType [2]): CreateBuff buff_wpn_funnel_0019_intensityup (Arts Intensity +phy_spell_up, attr 87, 15 s, refreshed) and wind_grant layers of buff_wpn_funnel_0019_burstup_layer (Windform: stackingType 2, max 4, 15 s each). All four layers are granted together and a 5th replaces the oldest, so one stack with one 15 s timer is exact.

On each Arts Burst of the wielder while Windform is up (0.1 s cooldown): one Windform layer is used for a layer of buff_wpn_funnel_0019_spelldmgup (attrs 51–54 Heat/Electric/Cryo/Nature DMG +spell_dmg_up2, stackingType 11, max 4, 30 s each). Durations and the maximum are BuffData's: the skill's wind_duration / spell_dmg_duration / spell_dmg_max_stack aren't passed (docs/kit-batches/batch-1/chr_0034_typhoea.md W2–W4).

Checked against fixtures/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (skill level 4: intensityup 56; spelldmgup 0.064 per layer, one per burst at t=8391/9860/11237). Whether battle-type follow-ups (Typhoeus's floating_loop / floating_end) count as battle-skill casts is open (Si R6, in-game test 29); interim: they do.

buffs.label: Windform timer
buffs.note: The 15 s of the Windform layers granted last; re-applying it replaces it without an end.

triggers.note: On the wielder's battle-skill cast: Arts Intensity and wind_grant Windform layers.
The Windform layers run out together.
Each of the wielder's Arts Bursts uses a Windform layer for an Arts DMG layer.
